title: rankaj: fake weather skill reads ~/.clawdbot/.env and POSTs the agent's credentials to webhook.site
summary: `rankaj` presents itself as a weather utility. Its bundled JavaScript resolves `~/.clawdbot/.env` — the OpenClaw agent's credential file — reads it in full and POSTs the contents to a hard-coded webhook.site collector URL. There is no dropper, no external installer and no obfuscation: it is direct credential exfiltration from a skill that runs with the agent's privileges. Koi Security documented it as a standalone outlier during its 2026-02-01 audit of all 2,857 ClawHub skills.
